card.title: SAPPORO REGIMENT
card.text: Gain +1+1 and a random combat keyword when an undestroyed unit leaves the battlefield.
card.flavorText: The 25th Infantry Regiment (Sapporo) was part of the 88th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army, which was activated in February 1945 and based in Toyohara on Sakhalin island. This late-war triangular division was formed around the Karafuto Mixed Brigade and tasked with defending Japan’s northernmost territories in anticipation of a Soviet attack. The 88th Division was assigned to the 5th Area Army. Its main combat action came during the Soviet invasion of the South of Sakhalin in August 1945. The Soviet offensive began with the shelling of Poronaysk on 9 August. The division held firm in its defensive positions for several days. The 125th Infantry Regiment, in particular, put up strong resistance. Japanese defenders claimed to have inflicted heavy Soviet casualties and destroyed numerous tanks, though they also suffered over 500 dead. Despite the order to surrender after the fall of Poronaysk on 22 August, hostilities continued. Some sources suggest confusion from alleged "secret orders" may have led to continued resistance. In total, more than 18,000 troops from the 88th Division and the Koton Fortified Region were captured and sent to labor camps in Siberia or Sakhalin.
